Open clipboard history
behaviour: Opens the Emoji and more panel on its clipboard tab.

label: Open the emoji panel
behaviour: Opens the Emoji and more panel on its most recently used tab; Win+; does the same.

label: Open the capture bar
behaviour: Freezes the screen and shows the capture bar at the top centre.

label: Start voice typing
behaviour: Opens the voice typing bar and starts listening.

label: Open the power user menu
behaviour: Opens the power user menu above the Start button, as a right-click on Start does.

label: Open Project
behaviour: Opens Quick Settings on its Project page.

label: Open Cast
behaviour: Opens Quick Settings on its Cast page.

label: Reopens where it was left
behaviour: The panel opens again on the tab and category last used; a category page shows Back in place of the tab row.

label: Never takes the focus
behaviour: The keyboard never takes the keyboard focus: keys type into the focused field, Esc does not reach its menus, and its settings button closes them.

label: Follows the focused field
behaviour: The layer follows the focused field's input scope: a URL field adds / and .com keys, a number field opens on the numbers and symbols layer, a password field keeps the letters; an empty text field starts in capitals.

label: Suggests the clipboard
behaviour: Above the keys the keyboard offers the clipboard's newest text as a suggestion.

label: Emoji above the keys
behaviour: With a field focused, the emoji button shows the Emoji and more panel's tab row and lists above the keys; it does nothing with no field focused.

label: Gamepad key names
behaviour: The gamepad layout names the controller button for each action key, such as Backspace on X.

label: Esc closes the menu first
behaviour: With the mode menu open, Esc closes only the menu; a second Esc leaves the capture bar.
